summary: Replay fails when Update handlers containing SideEffect or LocalActivity complete during the same workflow task as getVersion markers, because UpdateCompleted events are interleaved between version markers in the history.
userImpact: Users who use Update handlers with SideEffect or LocalActivity in workflows with versioning experience workflow task failures during replay.
rootCause: The SDK state machine has a bug when Update completions interleave with version markers, causing events to be recorded in a different order than they're replayed, breaking determinism.
workaround: Use Workflow.await(Workflow::isEveryHandlerFinished) before getVersion calls to prevent the race condition.
keyQuote: The UpdateCompleted events are interleaved between two version marker events in history, causing a mismatch during replay.
